215:     # Re-scale est velocities to match ref
216:     est_matched_velocities = slope * est_matched_velocities + intercept
217:     # Compute the absolute error of (rescaled) estimated velocities vs.
218:     # normalized reference velocities. Error will be in [0, 1]
219:     velocity_diff = np.abs(est_matched_velocities - ref_matched_velocities)
220:     # Check whether each error is within the provided tolerance
221:     velocity_within_tolerance = velocity_diff < velocity_tolerance
222:     # Only keep matches whose velocity was within the provided tolerance
223:     matching = matching[velocity_within_tolerance]
224:     # Convert back to list-of-tuple format
225:     matching = [tuple(_) for _ in matching]
226: 
227:     return matching
228: 
229: 
230: def precision_recall_f1_overlap(
231:     ref_intervals,
232:     ref_pitches,
233:     ref_velocities,
234:     est_intervals,
235:     est_pitches,
236:     est_velocities,
237:     onset_tolerance=0.05,
238:     pitch_tolerance=50.0,
239:     offset_ratio=0.2,
240:     offset_min_tolerance=0.05,
241:     strict=False,
242:     velocity_tolerance=0.1,
243:     beta=1.0,
244: ):
245:     """Compute the Precision, Recall and F-measure of correct vs incorrectly
246:     transcribed notes, and the Average Overlap Ratio for correctly transcribed
247:     notes (see :func:`mir_eval.transcription.average_overlap_ratio`).
248:     "Correctness" is determined based on note onset, velocity, pitch and
249:     (optionally) offset. An estimated note is considered correct if
250: 
251:     1. Its onset is within ``onset_tolerance`` (default +-50ms) of a
252:        reference note
253:     2. Its pitch (F0) is within +/- ``pitch_tolerance`` (default one
254:        quarter tone, 50 cents) of the corresponding reference note
255:     3. Its velocity, after normalizing reference velocities to the range
256:        [0, 1] and globally rescaling estimated velocities to minimize L2
257:        distance between matched reference notes, is within
258:        ``velocity_tolerance`` (default 0.1) the corresponding reference note
259:     4. If ``offset_ratio`` is ``None``, note offsets are ignored in the
260:        comparison. Otherwise, on top of the above requirements, a correct
261:        returned note is required to have an offset value within
262:        `offset_ratio`` (default 20%) of the reference note's duration around
263:        the reference note's offset, or within ``offset_min_tolerance``
264:        (default 50 ms), whichever is larger.
265: 
266:     Parameters
267:     ----------
268:     ref_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(n,2)
269:         Array of reference notes time intervals (onset and offset times)
270:     ref_pitches : np.ndarray, shape=(n,)
271:         Array of reference pitch values in Hertz
272:     ref_velocities : np.ndarray, shape=(n,)
273:         Array of MIDI velocities (i.e. between 0 and 127) of reference notes
274:     est_intervals : np.ndarray, shape=(m,2)
275:         Array of estimated notes time intervals (onset and offset times)
276:     est_pitches : np.ndarray, shape=(m,)
277:         Array of estimated pitch values in Hertz
278:     est_velocities : np.ndarray, shape=(n,)
279:         Array of MIDI velocities (i.e. between 0 and 127) of estimated notes
280:     onset_tolerance : float > 0
281:         The tolerance for an estimated note's onset deviating from the
282:         reference note's onset, in seconds. Default is 0.05 (50 ms).
283:     pitch_tolerance : float > 0
284:         The tolerance for an estimated note's pitch deviating from the
285:         reference note's pitch, in cents. Default is 50.0 (50 cents).
286:     offset_ratio : float > 0 or None
287:         The ratio of the reference note's duration used to define the
288:         offset_tolerance. Default is 0.2 (20%), meaning the
289:         ``offset_tolerance`` will equal the ``ref_duration * 0.2``, or
290:         ``offset_min_tolerance`` (0.05 by default, i.e. 50 ms), whichever is
291:         greater. If ``offset_ratio`` is set to ``None``, offsets are ignored in
292:         the evaluation.
293:     offset_min_tolerance : float > 0
294:         The minimum tolerance for offset matching. See ``offset_ratio``
295:         description for an explanation of how the offset tolerance is
296:         determined. Note: this parameter only influences the results if
297:         ``offset_ratio`` is not ``None``.
298:     strict : bool
299:         If ``strict=False`` (the default), threshold checks for onset, offset,
300:         and pitch matching are performed using ``<=`` (less than or equal). If
301:         ``strict=True``, the threshold checks are performed using ``<`` (less
302:         than).
303:     velocity_tolerance : float > 0
304:         Estimated notes are considered correct if, after rescaling and
305:         normalization to [0, 1], they are within ``velocity_tolerance`` of a
306:         matched reference note.
307:     beta : float > 0
308:         Weighting factor for f-measure (default value = 1.0).
309: 
310:     Returns
311:     -------
312:     precision : float
313:         The computed precision score
314:     recall : float
315:         The computed recall score
316:     f_measure : float
317:         The computed F-measure score
318:     avg_overlap_ratio : float
319:         The computed Average Overlap Ratio score
320:     """
321:     validate(
322:         ref_intervals,
323:         ref_pitches,
324:         ref_velocities,
325:         est_intervals,
326:         est_pitches,
327:         est_velocities,
328:     )
329:     # When reference notes are empty, metrics are undefined, return 0's
330:     if len(ref_pitches) == 0 or len(est_pitches) == 0:
331:         return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
332: 
333:     matching = match_notes(
334:         ref_intervals,
335:         ref_pitches,
336:         ref_velocities,
337:         est_intervals,
338:         est_pitches,
339:         est_velocities,
340:         onset_tolerance,
341:         pitch_tolerance,
342:         offset_ratio,
343:         offset_min_tolerance,
344:         strict,
345:         velocity_tolerance,
346:     )
347: 
348:     precision = float(len(matching)) / len(est_pitches)
349:     recall = float(len(matching)) / len(ref_pitches)
350:     f_measure = util.f_measure(precision, recall, beta=beta)
351: 
352:     avg_overlap_ratio = transcription.average_overlap_ratio(
353:         ref_intervals, est_intervals, matching
354:     )
355: 
356:     return precision, recall, f_measure, avg_overlap_ratio
357: 
358: 
359: def evaluate(
360:     ref_intervals,
361:     ref_pitches,
362:     ref_velocities,
363:     est_intervals,
364:     est_pitches,
365:     est_velocities,
366:     **kwargs
367: ):
368:     """Compute all metrics for the given reference and estimated annotations.
369: 
370:     Parameters
